title: 第262章 不是故事第261章 闹了个大红脸
content_zh:
“那……那村长你先坐，我去给你泡茶。”
陈慧兰说罢就急匆匆的朝着厨房跑去，甚至都不敢回头看一眼苏玉洁。
苏玉洁也没客气，直接就在赵富贵对面的沙发上坐下了。
“你可真是艳福不浅啊，赵大爷，虽然打了个半辈子光棍，到现在都没有儿女，可是有陈慧兰这个既年轻又漂亮的大美女陪着你，以前缺的那份儿也算是补回来了。”苏玉洁笑道，而且还一脸的揶揄之色。
赵富贵老脸一红，说道：“村长你就别埋汰我了，有事说事吧。”
“行，那咱们就说正事……我来找你还是为了钱思雨投资的事情。”苏玉洁说道。
见赵富贵想开口，苏玉洁立即抬起一只纤纤玉手阻止他，并接着说道：“我知道你想说什么，你想说钱家的人都不是好东西，那个钱博中更不是好东西，是不是这样？”
“没错。”赵富贵直接坦率承认。
苏玉洁没好气的说道：“我又不是傻子，你以为我看不出来？而且我和警务署署长沈良通电话的时候，沈良也提醒我了。”
“既然村长你什么都知道，那你为什么还要这样？”赵富贵问道。
“当然是为了咱们村子！”苏玉洁重重说道。
略微停顿，苏玉洁又说道：“那个钱博中是不是罪犯我不关心，我只关心咱们村子能不能发展起来，咱们村的村民能不能富裕起来。我想让咱们村的村民都过上比以前更好的生活，都顿顿有肉吃，都开上小汽车，生活奔小康。”
“只要能达到这个目的，那么有些事情就值得做出让步。而且我还专门了解了一下，那个钱博中就只是非法持有枪械而已，他并没有杀人什么的。既然如此，那也没有必要斤斤计较。”
“赵大爷，我给你讲个故事吧……不，这并不是故事，而是真实发生的事情。”
赵富贵被苏玉洁的话勾起了好奇，于是就点点头做出一副洗耳恭听的样子。
苏玉洁缓缓说道：“你知道我妈妈苏淑珍，为什么在县首的这个位子上干了十几年，都没有升迁吗？”
“为什么？”赵富贵问道，而且心里更好奇了。
苏玉洁的妈妈苏淑珍，这位桃花县有史以来的第一位女县首，名气大的不得了。
而且在苏淑珍的治理下，桃花县实现了经济飞跃，短短十几年的功夫gdp就翻了好几倍，明明只是一个小县城却足以媲美一个三四线城市了。
几年前好多人都在传，说苏淑珍功绩显著，能力那么强，肯定要升迁了，十有八九会去兰花市做更大的官儿。

可直到现在苏淑珍都没有升迁，仍旧停留在桃花县的县首这个位子上，一点动一下的迹象都没有。
本来赵富贵就挺疑惑的，现在听到苏玉洁这么说，顿时更疑惑了。
苏玉洁苦笑着说道：“因为我妈犯了一个错误，很严重的错误……”
“八年前，咱们桃花县还是一个很穷很落后的小县城，而穷困落后的根本原因就是交通不便。你也知道，咱们桃花县的地理位置十分特殊，一面靠山，三面环水。不要说去其他地方了，就是去一趟兰花市都很不方便。”
“我妈担任桃花县的县首以后，一直都想改变这个现状。一面靠山的问题难以解决，但三面环水的问题相对而言就比较好解决了，只要建设三座大桥即可。但是建设大桥要钱啊，县务府根本就没有那么多钱，而且上级部门也不愿意给咱们这个穷困潦倒的小县城拨款，你说这该怎么办？”
赵富贵心里隐隐产生了不好的预感，而苏玉洁接下来所说的话，完美的映证了他的这个预感。
“说来也巧，兰花市的一个富商的儿子在咱们桃花县犯了事儿，强暴了一个女孩，按理来说是要判刑的。”
“那个富商先是找了警务署的署长梁群峰……当时警务署的署长就是梁群峰，而非沈良，沈良当时只不过是警务署里的一个大队长，扯远了……那个富商找到梁群峰，想用钱打通关系把他儿子捞出来。”
“梁群峰自然是不答应的，身为警务署的署长他怎么可能干这种事，后来那个富商就找到我妈。”
“那个富商先是给我妈送礼送钱，我妈都不肯收，没想到那个富商竟然说愿意注资，帮咱们桃花县搞经济建设，我妈终于心动了。她亲自给梁群峰打电话，将那个富商的儿子从警务署里放了出来，而且她还亲自带着干部去那个被强暴的女孩家里慰问，安抚他们一家的情绪，给那家人做思想工作。”
“于是这件事被我妈摆平了，那起强暴案没有公开，更没有宣传通告，可以说是我妈一个人把那件事的影响压了下来。后来我妈就靠着那个富商提供的资金，勉勉强强的在咱们桃花县修了三座大桥。那三座大桥你肯定都知道，分别是清溪大桥，凤凰大桥和金龙大桥。”
“要致富先修路这话可不是说着玩的，自从有了这三座大桥，桃花县的经济贸易迅速上升，整个县城都欣欣向荣。”
说到这里，苏玉洁就深深的叹了口气。
“然后我妈主动向上级部门坦白，承认了自己的错误，自愿接受组织的一切处理决定。”
“接下来的事情就不用我说了吧，虽然组织对我妈的处分没有公开，我妈仍旧是桃花县的县首，但她这辈子都不可能升迁了。如果没有这个错误的影响，我妈早就不是桃花县的县首了，十有八九都已经是兰花市的市首了，说不定还能更进一步，进入省务……”
说到这里苏玉洁连忙停了下来，不敢再往下说。
赵富贵问道：“那个梁群峰呢？”
“梁群峰的结果其实也还挺不错，虽然在我妈主动坦白错误以后，他受到了牵连，没能保住警务署署长的位子，并且被调到了闲职上，但待遇什么的并不差。”苏玉洁说道。
赵富贵脸上的表情复杂极了。
“那个富商呢？他的儿子呢？”赵富贵又问。

content_en:
"Then... village chief, you sit down first, and I'll make you tea."
After Chen Huilan said that, she hurried towards the kitchen, not even daring to look back at Su Yujie.
Su Yujie was not polite and sat down directly on the sofa opposite Zhao Fugui.
"You are really blessed, Uncle Zhao. Although you have been a bachelor for half your life and still have no children, but with Chen Huilan, a young and beautiful beauty, by your side, you can make up for what you lacked before." Su Yujie said with a smile, with a teasing look on her face.
Zhao Fugui blushed and said, "Village Chief, please don't bury me. Tell me what you have to say."
"Okay, let's get down to business...I came to you about Qian Siyu's investment." Su Yujie said.
Seeing that Zhao Fugui wanted to speak, Su Yujie immediately raised a slender hand to stop him, and continued: "I know what you want to say. You want to say that the people in the Qian family are not good people, and that Qian Bozhong is not a good person, is that right?"
"That's right." Zhao Fugui admitted directly and frankly.
Su Yujie said angrily: "I'm not a fool. Do you think I can't see it? And when I was on the phone with Police Commissioner Shen Liang, Shen Liang also reminded me."
"Since you know everything, village chief, why are you still like this?" Zhao Fugui asked.
"Of course it's for our village!" Su Yujie said seriously.
After a slight pause, Su Yujie continued: "I don't care whether Qian Bozhong is a criminal. I only care about whether our village can develop and whether the villagers in our village can become rich. I want the villagers in our village to live a better life than before. They will have meat every day, drive cars, and live a well-off life."
"As long as this goal can be achieved, then some things are worth making concessions. And I also learned that Qian Bozhong only illegally held firearms. He did not kill anyone. In this case, there is no need to worry about it."
"Uncle Zhao, let me tell you a story... No, this is not a story, but what really happened."
Zhao Fugui was aroused by Su Yujie's words, so he nodded and looked like he was all ears.
Su Yujie said slowly: "Do you know why my mother, Su Shuzhen, has not been promoted despite working at the county head for more than ten years?"
"Why?" Zhao Fugui asked, becoming even more curious.
Su Yujie's mother Su Shuzhen, the first female county chief in the history of Taohua County, is extremely famous.
Moreover, under Su Shuzhen's governance, Taohua County has achieved an economic leap. In just a dozen years, its GDP has increased several times. Although it is only a small county, it is comparable to a third- and fourth-tier city.
A few years ago, many people were spreading rumors that Su Shuzhen had made outstanding achievements and was so capable that she would definitely be promoted and would most likely go to Orchid City to become a bigger official.
But until now, Su Shuzhen has not been promoted, and she still stays at the position of the county head of Taohua County, with no sign of moving at all.
Zhao Fugui was quite confused at first, but now that he heard Su Yujie say this, he became even more confused.
Su Yujie smiled bitterly and said, "Because my mother made a mistake, a very serious mistake..."
"Eight years ago, our Taohua County was still a very poor and backward small county, and the fundamental reason for poverty and backwardness was inconvenient transportation. As you know, our Taohua County has a very special geographical location, with mountains on one side and water on three sides. Not to mention going to other places, even a trip to the Orchid City is very inconvenient."
"My mother has always wanted to change this situation since she became the head of Taohua County. The problem of being surrounded by mountains on one side is difficult to solve, but the problem of being surrounded by water on three sides is relatively easy to solve. Just build three bridges. But building bridges requires money, and the county government does not have that much money at all, and the superiorsThe department is also unwilling to allocate funds to our small and impoverished county. What do you think we should do? "
Zhao Fugui had a bad premonition in his heart, and what Su Yujie said next perfectly confirmed his premonition.
"It's a coincidence that the son of a wealthy businessman from Lanhua City committed a crime in our Taohua County and raped a girl. Logically speaking, he should be sentenced. "
"The wealthy businessman first approached Liang Qunfeng, the director of the police station... The director of the police station at that time was Liang Qunfeng, not Shen Liang. Shen Liang was just a captain in the police station at the time, which is too far... The wealthy businessman approached Liang Qunfeng and wanted to use money to build connections to get his son out. "
"Liang Qunfeng naturally refused. As the commissioner of the police station, how could he do such a thing? Later, the wealthy businessman found my mother. "
"The wealthy businessman first gave my mother gifts and money, but my mother refused to accept them. Unexpectedly, the wealthy businessman actually said that he was willing to inject capital to help our Taohua County with economic development. My mother was finally moved. She personally called Liang Qunfeng and released the wealthy businessman's son from the police station. She also personally took the cadres to the home of the raped girl to express condolences, calm the family's emotions, and do ideological work for the family. "
"So the matter was settled by my mother. The rape case was not made public, and there was no publicity notice. It can be said that my mother alone suppressed the impact of the incident. Later, my mother reluctantly built three bridges in our Taohua County with the funds provided by the wealthy businessman. You must all know those three bridges, namely Qingxi Bridge, Phoenix Bridge and Jinlong Bridge. "
“It’s no joke that if you want to get rich, you must first build roads. Since the establishment of these three bridges, Taohua County’s economy and trade have increased rapidly, and the entire county is thriving. "
At this point, Su Yujie sighed deeply.
"Then my mother took the initiative to confess to the superior department, admitted her mistakes, and voluntarily accepted all the organization's decisions. "
"I don't need to tell you what happens next. Although the organization's punishment of my mother has not been made public, my mother is still the head of Taohua County, but she will never be promoted in this life. Without the influence of this mistake, my mother would no longer be the county head of Taohua County, but most likely the city head of Orchid City, and maybe she could go one step further and enter the provincial affairs..."
At this point, Su Yujie stopped quickly, not daring to say any more.
Zhao Fugui asked: "Where is Liang Qunfeng? "
"Liang Qunfeng's results were actually quite good. Although after my mother took the initiative to confess her mistake, he was implicated and failed to retain his position as police chief, and was transferred to a casual position, but the treatment was not bad. "Su Yujie said.
The expression on Zhao Fugui's face was extremely complicated.
"Where's the rich businessman? Where is his son? "Zhao Fugui asked again.
